concept.title: Open to everyone
concept.shortdesc: Services open to people of any age or ability, or to general groups such as men, club members and those wanting to meet people.

conbody.note: Draft group. Groups are a convenience for browsing the draft: the hierarchy was proposed by a second clustering pass and named by a language model, and no person has reviewed it.

ul.li: : People who want to make friends, widen their social circle or get out of the house for company and social activity.
: Open to people of any age and any level of ability or condition, with no restriction on who can take part.
: Services aimed at men or male-only groups, whatever their age or background.
: Open to anyone of any age, from children to older people, with no age restriction.
: Services open to people of any ability or skill level, with no ability requirement for taking part.
: Services for the members of a club, society or group, including those that say whether non-members may also take part.
